newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Kmart rises after results.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Kmart rises after results.

text.p: Shares of retailer Kmart Corp rose in pre-opening trade Thursday after the company reported second-quarter results.

The Troy, Mich., company was trading at 12-1/16 from a Wednesday close of 11-12/16. Kmart earlier reported that improved sales had boosted its second-quarter profites and said its earnings per share rose to $0.06 against $0.05 for the same period a year before.
Traders reported little other activity. Among other stocks, semiconductor maker Micron Technology Inc rose slightly to 42-7/8 from a closing price of 42-10/16.

Xylan Corp fell to 17-5/8 from a close of 17-8/16. Cannondale Corp eased to 17-3/8 from a close of 17-10/16 after it reported fourth-quarter earnings per share of $0.48 against $0.39 for the same period a year before.
Lucent Technologies Inc was not active after the company said it would take a $950 million after-tax charge in the fourth quarter related to its $1.8 billion purchase of Octel Communications.
"People haven't gotten on that one yet," a trader said.
